data.narrative:
Becoming is a Biotech & Health company founded by Divya Cohen and Jack Cohen at an undisclosed stage. The valuation analysis draws from a broader peer universe of 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, New Limit, Recursion Pharmaceuticals, and Freenome.

Two standard triangulation methods prove inapplicable here. Peer-median analysis cannot proceed because the narrow filters—same-stage, adjacent-stage, and similar-valuation-tier—yield fewer than three datapoints within Biotech & Health, despite 7 same-sector peers existing in the broader universe. Public-comp anchoring is similarly constrained: while the public Biotech & Health sector median trades at 8.1x Price-to-Sales across the three tickers, Becoming's revenue is not on file, as is typical for private companies, preventing P/S multiple application.

Without disclosed financials, stage information, or prior valuation, this analysis cannot produce a supported range. The presence of well-funded private peers and a modest public comparable set suggests the relevant valuation universe is defined, but the absence of target-specific revenue, EBITDA, or explicit stage classification precludes quantitative synthesis. Further disclosure of Becoming's annual revenue, burn rate, or funding stage would enable application of either peer multiples or venture-stage benchmarks.
